recipe_version.title: Polish Krupnik: Mushroom and Barley Soup with Dill
recipe_version.description: A hearty Polish barley soup built on dried porcini and fresh cremini mushrooms, with carrot, parsnip, celery, and potato, scented with bay and allspice and finished with plenty of fresh dill.

steps.title: Soak and prep
steps.body: Pour 1 cup boiling water over the porcini in a small bowl and soak 15 minutes. Meanwhile dice the onion, carrots, parsnip, celery, and potatoes, slice the cremini, mince the garlic, rinse the barley, and chop the dill. Lift out the porcini, chop them, and strain the 1 cup soaking water through a fine-mesh strainer to remove grit.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.body: Heat the oil in the soup pot over medium. Cook the onion, carrots, parsnip, and celery 5 minutes. Add the cremini and porcini and cook until the mushrooms release their liquid and brown lightly, 6 minutes; add the garlic for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer the barley
steps.body: Add the barley, the 1 cup strained porcini water, 9 cups water, the bay leaves, allspice, 2 1/2 tsp salt, and the pepper. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered 25 minutes.

steps.title: Add the potatoes
steps.body: Add the potatoes and simmer until they and the barley are tender, 15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Remove the bay leaves and allspice berries. Stir in most of the dill, taste for salt, and serve topped with the rest.
